description: MVP v0.1 supported drug scope. Ingredient definitions (RxNorm IN with verified precise ingredients and aliases) are separate from drug/formulation eligibility (exact ingredient set plus optional route, prescription-scope, salt, dose-form, release and strength restrictions). Version 0.3.0 (proposed) extends the scope to the top 200 Medicare Part D 2023 generic names by total claims that pass the same checks.
